children: Japanese stocks may consolidate amid lingering worry over the artificial-intelligence boom. Investors remain concerned over whether AI-related companies can generate sufficient profits to meet rising credit obligations amid still-elevated yields. Nikkei futures opened 30 points lower at 64855 on the SGX. The dollar is at 158.58 yen versus Y158.10 around Monday's Tokyo market close. The Nikkei Stock Average closed 0.6% lower at 64916.70 on Monday. (ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
